gloss: principal (offender); person who commits the crime directly

definitions.gloss: principal (offender); person who commits the crime directly
definitions.explanation: A legal term for the person who personally carries out the criminal act, as opposed to an accomplice or accessory. Under Japanese criminal law, the principal is distinguished from those who merely aid, abet, or instigate the crime, and is generally subject to the full penalty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{正犯|せいはん}だ。
{正犯|せいはん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}される→区別する：26970_kubetsusuru⟧。
examples.english: A distinction is made between principal offenders and accomplices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正犯|せいはん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{断定|だんてい}→断定：04519_dantei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police concluded that the man was the principal offender in the case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{正犯|せいはん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{従犯|じゅうはん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧をめぐって⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交|か}わされた→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: At the trial, heated arguments were exchanged over whether the defendant was the principal or an accessory.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ (main; direct) and {犯|はん} (perpetrator; crime). The ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ prefix marks the direct, main actor — contrasted with {共|きょう} (joint) in ⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧ or {従|じゅう} (secondary) in {従犯|じゅうはん}.

USAGE:
A technical criminal-law term used in the Penal Code, court judgments, and crime reporting. In everyday speech, people say ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧ instead. Japanese law recognizes several categories of {正犯|せいはん}: ⟦{単独|たんどく}→単独：05613_tandoku⟧{正犯|せいはん} (sole principal), ⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧{正犯|せいはん} (co-principals who act together), and ⟦{間接|かんせつ}→間接：00180_kansetsu⟧{正犯|せいはん} (indirect principal — one who uses another as a tool).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧{正犯|せいはん}: co-principal (jointly acting perpetrators)
- ⟦{間接|かんせつ}→間接：00180_kansetsu⟧{正犯|せいはん}: indirect principal
- {正犯|せいはん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}する→起訴する：09863_kisosuru⟧: to indict as a principal offender
- {正犯|せいはん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧: principal and accomplice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧: accomplice; co-offender — general term for anyone involved besides the sole principal
- {従犯|じゅうはん}: accessory — one who helps the principal but does not directly carry out the crime
- ⟦{主犯|しゅはん}→主犯：18011_shuhan⟧: ringleader; chief perpetrator — a media/everyday word emphasizing the leader of a group, not a strict legal category
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧: offender; culprit — the general, non-technical word for whoever did it
